special_cases: footnote rows: rows marked *** (after most parcels) hold extension areas of existing buildings, per the page note 'Redovi oznaceni sa *** predstavljaju površine za nadogradnju i dogradnju ...'; they are not parcels and no parcel value comes from them (UP 77 and UP 91 have such a row with a blank Blok cell instead of ***)

merged cells: IZ and II are printed once, centred over a parcel row and its *** row(s); UP 51(a)-(c), UP 81(a)-(d) and UP 85(a)-(f) share one area, land use, IZ and II printed once over the group, while floors differ per row: the values apply to every row they span
wrapped cells: areas wrap in the narrow column (5705.1 / 7 = 5705.17), floor notations too ('S+P+3+ / M', 'G+S+P+5+P / k' in small print)

deferred: UP 1 and UP 25 carry one merged cell 'definisaće se konkursnim rješenjem' (set by an architectural competition) over ground floor, floors, BGP and both indices; their land use adds '- prostor namjenjen za razradu konkursnim rjesenjem'
blank cells: UP 15 and UP 26 print no land use, UP 86 (sport i rekreacija) no floors or indices, UP 24 ('3S') and UP 33 ('S') no indices: nothing may be filled in

block totals: a 'UKUPNO BLOK A..F' row per block states the block's sums (areas, BGP, dwellings, employees); the last digit of a total often wraps into the bottom of its cell; 'UKUPNO SVE ZONE' on page 11 is the plan-wide total (not a block)
annex row: UP 58 is followed by an 'aneks' row (floors 3S+P+3) inside UP 58's merged IZ / II cell: not the parcel's floors
ratio indices: IZ printed as a plain ratio ('1' = 100 %), II as a plain number; UP 43 states IZ 0.7 with II 5.48 (as printed, not checked against the floors)
not_covered: heights in metres, building lines, setbacks, parking, green area, utilities: not in this table (these fields must stay blank)
parameter ranges ('P+2 do P+4'): no range is printed in this document
parcels listed twice (superseded amendment vs current): every parcel number appears once
gazette, decision number and date, area: not on these pages
